name: Subconscious answer sweep — capture replies to noticer questions
notes: Hourly sweeper behind the per-turn answer check: judges asked-but-unanswered noticer questions against the user chat that followed (answer_matcher, cheap model), marks captured answers, annotates the related concern, and triggers an immediate noticer tick. No open questions = pure SQL no-op, so the hourly cadence costs nothing in the common case.
